description: Red sample pool exported from the two latest 19011 SIP P1 calls after the 2026-07-13 authority changes. This is intentionally a triage corpus, not a green regression gate: failing samples identify repeated fan/noise false pre-stops and Chinese short-utterance slow pre-stops that must be fixed only after cross-sample evidence is reviewed.

policy.privacyFiltering: Only P1 evaluator events and compact dialogue fields are stored; orchestration, phone hash, recording object names, and provider configuration events are omitted.
policy.promotionRule: Do not patch runtime from a single failed call. Promote to authority/audio fixtures or main matrix only after the same failure pattern repeats across multiple samples and has a positive/negative control pair.
